text: The place isn't bad, but they really need to manage their queuing system. I've used their services more than 10 times, and each time I've waited at least half an hour, sometimes almost two hours. Before buying a course, I always ask if there are available slots. If there aren't any, they should just say so directly so I can find another day. They shouldn't just tell me I can sit and wait. They really need to improve this a lot. In the past, I've tried to let it slide, but recently, I had an appointment in advance, I didn't walk in. I arrived early and submitted my card before my appointment time. I went out to run an errand for less than 5 minutes and then came back to wait (I returned before my appointment time). 40 minutes passed since my appointment and they still hadn't called me. People who arrived later had already cut in line (this doesn't include the time I spent submitting my card, because I understand that I arrived early, but if you include the time I spent submitting my card, I waited for over an hour). I had to go and ask if my name had been moved to the queue. It turned out my name wasn't on the queue because they hadn't put the chart on the table. They gave the reason that they didn't know when I would return. If I returned, I had to inform the counter. It's confusing. When we get a queue number at a bank or hospital, do we have to inform the bank staff when we return? No. Instead of putting a queue number on the table, they just let us in. If a client doesn't show up for their appointment, they should simply be skipped, and the client must accept the wait because they were late. That's how it should be. If we're skipped because of our own mistake, we accept it. I will update my review once this issue is resolved. The staff in the treatment room were polite, which is why I'm still giving a rating.
